risks: maplibre-gl is browser-only: it must live in a client component loaded without SSR (dynamic import or guarded mount) or next build breaks; this is its FIRST import - watch bundle impact and keep it scoped to the confirm surface
WebGL is not guaranteed in headless CI Chromium: the component must detect unavailability and render the honest typed fallback; Playwright asserts stable copy/attribution/testids, never pixels
display-only discipline: any area/dimension/measurement math from 4326 coordinates in web code is a defect (grep-provable); the map only DRAWS what the contract delivered
flag discipline: INTERNAL_RULE_EVAL_ENABLED stays server-read; never introduce a NEXT_PUBLIC flag mirror; the surface inherits the PropertyLookup gate

generated lot_geometry.ts must stay byte-identical when the generator is wired; a diff means the wiring diverges from what M5-T020 generated - reconcile, never silently regenerate the committed artifact
the ZoLa link, its BBL-absent branch, and the +/-20ft approximate-outline copy are KEEP requirements; removing or weakening them fails G3

bounded reflection: every string reflected from the response goes through boundedText/boundedToken before rendering; geometry coordinates are validated as numbers before reaching MapLibre; nothing from the response is interpolated into map style expressions
